name: dsh-raw-html-v2

one_liner.zh: 在 DSH 网页对话中流式渲染 VCP HTML 卡片
one_liner.en: Render streaming VCP HTML cards in DSH web chats

local: Can serve user-selected font directories through the local DSH web server.

readme_mismatch: README gives package version examples as 0.7.28, while package.json at the analyzed commit declares 0.8.0.

completeness.reason: The host and web client implement the main render, prompt, font, style, and card flows; image attachment blocks remain placeholders.

code.reason: Host and client responsibilities are separated, with fallback paths and local error boundaries across the main rendering flow.

docs.reason: README explains installation, toggles, fonts, rendering behavior, compatibility, and usage examples.

maintenance.reason: The repository has five recorded commits and its listed last push is about a month before this analysis.

tests.reason: Five test files are present; the repository has no CI workflow, so CI coverage is not established.

quality.notes: Maintenance and test scores use the list metadata and extracted quality_raw facts; five test files, no CI.
